finetune._comment: Modular head (Qtome_modules FeatureHead): each features entry is {type, its own keys} and gets its own spatial filter. Types: atom_power / atom_band (log power, time_pool flat|learned|window|none, time_rank, window), signed_ab (signed phase-locked: atom_rank, time_rank), evoked (evoked_rank), phase_advance, raw_band, raw_signal, latent_power / latent_signed (on the encoder output z). Default: the all-atom head, atom_power (induced band power, MI) + signed_ab (signed atom gains, phase-locked / P300); the stronger head swaps signed_ab for latent_signed (signed z, latent_proj pca). Any entry may set its own spatial_k (default below).
